_meta.source: City of San Diego Community Planning Groups Contact List, https://www.sandiego.gov/planning/community-plans/cpg/contacts
notes: Occurrences are pre-expanded from each group's weekday-ordinal rule because monthly nth-weekday recurrence with dark months and shifted months cannot be expressed with the native weekly recurrence object. Every item carries a seriesId so they can be grouped or collapsed later.
_series holds the underlying rule for each group if you would rather seed one recurring document per group.

Meeting dates are the published regular slot only. Special, joint, continued and cancelled meetings are not in here, and groups are only legally required to post physical notice at the venue 72 hours ahead.
_noFixedLocation lists groups that meet virtually or publish their location on the agenda. They are deliberately not in items[] because there is no venue to anchor a shell to.
_excluded lists planning areas with no active group.
_geoReview lists venues whose coordinates are street level or nearby rather than rooftop. Spot check those before seeding.
